title: A domain decomposition method for the directional contact angle hysteresis interval on doubly periodic rough surfaces
summary: We study wetting on a doubly periodic rough surface in three dimensions. Although the liquid-vapor interface meets the solid at the local Young's angle, microscale roughness can cause the macroscopic apparent angle to differ substantially from this value. We formulate the directional contact angle hysteresis (CAH) interval in terms of apparent angles associated with pinned microscopic configurations.
